claim.pdf_says: { 1 / 01 } constant-name-1 CONSTANT [ IS GLOBAL ] ... (both level numbers 1 and 01 printed underlined)
claim.why_it_matters: In the 13.9.1 constant-entry general format the printed level number '1' carries an underline just like '01'; the markdown underlines only 01, so the figure's notation for the required level-number alternative is lost for '1'.

verdict.reasoning: A 6x zoom crop of the 300 dpi render of PDF page 267 (printed page 245, §2002:13.9.1 General format) shows a short horizontal rule printed directly under the '1' in the top alternative of the level-number brace, and a longer rule under '01' in the bottom alternative. Both are underlined. The transcription (page-267.md line 13) writes the top alternative as a plain '1' and only line 15 has '<u>01</u>'. The quotes of both sources are accurate. In this notation an underline marks a required word or literal that must be written, so the transcription drops that mark from one of the two brace alternatives. The rest of the figure (CONSTANT, GLOBAL, the AS/FROM braces) matches the print.
